en: Black‑and‑white postcard view taken from a terrace with ornate balustrades and gas-style street lamps, showing a monumental equestrian statue on a richly decorated pedestal in the foreground. Below, landscaped gardens slope down toward a broad river spanned by a large suspension bridge with stone towers. On the opposite bank stands a dense cityscape of grand 19th‑century buildings. Several women and men in early 20th‑century clothing are strolling or posing on the terrace. The overall scene overlooks the Danube and the famous chain bridge of Budapest.
